keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job title, skill, or company to search for (maps to LinkedIn's search query). Supports boolean OR / quoted phrases.
keywords.prefill: "AI Engineer" OR "Applied AI Engineer" OR "Software Engineer, AI" OR "Machine Learning Engineer" OR "Artificial Intelligence Engineer"

location.title: Location
location.description: Geographic location, e.g. "United States", "London, England, United Kingdom", "Remote".

maxItems.title: Max jobs to scrape
maxItems.description: Stop after this many job listings have been collected.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Filter by how recently the job was posted.

experienceLevels.title: Experience level
experienceLevels.description: Filter by seniority level. Leave empty for all levels.

jobTypes.title: Job type
jobTypes.description: Filter by employment type. Leave empty for all types.

remoteFilter.title: Workplace type
remoteFilter.description: Filter by on-site / remote / hybrid. Leave empty for all.

titleKeywordFilter.title: Title synonym filter
titleKeywordFilter.description: After scraping, keep only jobs whose title contains one of these terms (whole-word, case-insensitive) — lets a broad search catch AI-related titles under any naming. Leave empty to disable and keep every result from the search.

fetchFullDescription.title: Fetch full job description
fetchFullDescription.description: If enabled, visits each job's detail page to collect the full description and extra fields. Roughly doubles the number of requests.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: LinkedIn aggressively rate-limits and blocks datacenter IPs. Residential proxies are strongly recommended.
